messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "high blood sugar when medicine is stopped"
set: ["high blood sugar when medicine is stopped", "blood sugar not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone", "high doses", "adults with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "blood clotting", "hormonal effects of medicine", "children 7 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "children 8 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "those at high risk for these events", "people with stable blood pressure and circulation after heart attack", "people with diabetes", "Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP)", "adults with type 2 diabetes", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "adults with type 2 diabetes and known heart disease", "patients with type 1 diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
